name: Teresa Leger Fernandez
stance: Wants a strong, enforceable national AI regulatory framework with civil and criminal liability, and rejects AI industry self-regulation.

statements.text: We cannot just let AI and data centers regulate themselves or depend on their goodwill to lower utility costs and limit the most destructive possibilities inherent in this rapidly evolving technology.
But Congress must act. There must be a strong, enforceable national regulatory framework. We must have civil and criminal liability.
